title: Full gate: source_observation_audit_rejects_wrong_receipts_without_releasing_the_provider returns Delivered instead of Held under full-suite load (passes in isolation)
outcome: The test passes deterministically under full-gate load. The nondeterminism is classified with evidence (test, product or runner) and fixed without retries, timeout inflation or weakening.
acceptance: A deterministic test that expires the turn-start capture deadline in the source-observation audit fixture shows the dispatch delivering with an Unmeasured opening and no source observation, which classifies the full-gate failure's cause.
Delivering without source evidence when the opening capture overruns its budget remains the product behavior, as documented, and the production capture budget is unchanged.

Source-observation fixtures control the turn-start capture's clock, so source_observation_audit_rejects_wrong_receipts_without_releasing_the_provider can reach the overrun path only when a test arms it; the fixtures' default wait for capture completion is bounded by the existing deadlock guard, so a capture that never completes fails the test rather than hanging; no retry, ignore or timeout increase is added.
Focused tests covering the change pass, and an independent Codex + Claude review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding on the final input.
